items.passage:
Drugs and the Olympic Games 1

1. It is no secret that performance-enhancing drugs have been used by Olympic athletes for decades. 2. According to an article in Forbes magazine, “From the brute steroids the East Germans reportedly used on their Olympians during the Cold War to today’s man-made versions of natural human proteins, drugs have been as much a staple of the Games as gold, silver, and bronze” (Herper, par. 4). 3. Despite rigorous drug testing, the use of banned performance-enhancing substances has become more widespread than ever. 4. The disqualification of athletes from the most recent Olympic Games because of illegal drug use shows that the problem is ongoing.

5. It seems apparent that if athletes want to win, they must consider using drugs. 6. Dr. Michael Karsten, a Dutch physician who said he had prescribed anabolic steroids to hundreds of world-class athletes, states, “If you are especially gifted, you may win once, but from my experience you can’t continue to win without drugs. 7. The field is just too filled with drug users” (qtd. in Bamberger and Yaeger 62). 8. In fact, some people claim that record-breaking performances of Olympic athletes may be directly due to drugs. 9. Charles Yesalis, a Pennsylvania State University professor who has studied the use of drugs in sports, believes “a large percentage” of athletes who have set new records have done so with the help of performance-enhancing drugs. 10. “A lot of experts, at least in private, feel that way,” he claims (qtd. in Herper, par. 6).

对照参考和讲解判断；合理同义表达不要求逐字相同。

rules.title: 观点需要具体依据
rules.explanation: fact 可查证，opinion 是判断；事实也需核对出处与语境。论点→证据→解释，避免只有引文没有自己的分析。教材旧数据是语言练习材料，不当作今天的统计。
rules.example: 原创示例：A quiet room supports concentration because it reduces interruptions.
steps: 先区分“评价/建议”与“可以核实的陈述”。
再看句子是否已经提供可核对的具体案例、数字或引语。
对O和F-NP提出所需证据，而不是用另一个空泛评价来支持。

breakdown.note: 如not severe enough包含价值判断，需要讲清标准和证据。
可核实不代表本句已经证明；most、rapidly等概括往往需要统计。
具体人物经历、带时间和来源的数量或直接引语，可用来支撑概括。

rules.pitfall: For example只是信号，不保证后面就是充分的具体证据；有数字也要核对年份、对象与来源。

check.prompt: 原创理解检查（非教材原题）：“Most students prefer online classes”尚未附调查，最合适的下一步是什么？

options.label: 反复说online classes are good
给出有来源的偏好调查，说明样本和时间
加上very most

check.explanation: most是比例概括，需要相关调查。该检查是原创，不冒充教材原题。

rules.title: 直接引语
rules.explanation: 保留原词，用引号并标来源。报告语在前通常接逗号；引号内句首大写。中间插入报告语时，原句第二部分不因此强制大写。
rules.example: 原创示例：The tutor said, "Review your notes carefully."
rules.before: The tutor said "review your notes carefully".
rules.after: The tutor said, "Review your notes carefully."
steps: 先标出说话人/报告语与逐字原话的边界。
给原话加成对引号，按整句或中断句放逗号和大小写。
删词用省略号，加词用方括号；引用中的引用用单引号。
最后检查文内引注及句号位置。

breakdown.note: The tutor said, “Read the whole sentence.”报告语后有逗号，Read大写。
“Read,” the tutor said, “the whole sentence.”后半句继续原句，不机械大写。
“...” (Lee 8). 句号放在括号后；短片语融入句中时不必强加逗号。

rules.pitfall: 直接引用必须准确；只换同义词却仍当逐字引语会失真。教材采用其版本的美式引用规则，具体考试依课程要求。

check.prompt: 原创理解检查（非教材原题）：同一句引语被报告语插开，后半句应怎样开始？

options.label: 总是大写
总是另起一句
根据原句结构继续，必要时小写

check.explanation: 大小写由是否是新句决定，不能仅凭出现了第二个引号判断。

rules.title: 间接引语
rules.explanation: 不加引号，按语境调整代词、时间词和时态。过去式报告动词常触发时态后移；仍成立的事实可保留现在时，不能机械后移。陈述语序保留。
rules.example: 原创示例：The tutor said that the task was useful.
rules.before: The tutor said that "the task was useful."
rules.after: The tutor said that the task was useful.
steps: 去掉整段直接引号，以报告动词和必要的that引出。
按转述视角调整I/you/my等指代。
先看报告动词时态，再判断是否后移；同时保持时间指向。
比较原句，核对信息与语气没有被改强或改弱。

breakdown.note: said + can通常变为said that ... could；will通常变would。
现在时报告动词、according to或一般真理，不机械后移。
now/last year是否变then/the previous year取决于转述时间；指向一致比机械换词重要。

rules.pitfall: 普通间接引语的人称改变不必一律加方括号；模型方括号用于显示对照中的替换。

check.prompt: 原创理解检查（非教材原题）：He says, “I can finish it today.”怎样转述最合适？

options.label: He says that he can finish it today.
He says that he could finish it yesterday.
He says that “he can finish it today.”

check.explanation: says是现在时，无须因转述就机械后移；整句不保留直接引号。

rules.title: 报告动词与解释
rules.explanation: according to、report、state、argue、suggest 反映来源立场；不要把 suggest 升格为 prove。引文后解释它如何支持主旨。
rules.example: 原创示例：The author argues that regular review is valuable. This view supports a daily practice plan.
steps: 确认报告的是谁的哪种立场。
选能准确表达立场的report、state、claim、suggest等动词。
用according to +来源，或主语+报告动词，避免双重框架。
引用后解释材料与本段主张的关系。
